title: OS Command Injection Prevention
content: OS Command Injection occurs when an application passes unsanitized user input to a system shell. PREVENTION: Use built-in API functions instead of shell commands. In Python, use the 'subprocess' module with 'shell=False'. Avoid 'os.system()'. Validate all input against a strict allow-list of characters.

title: SQL Injection Defensive Coding
content: SQL Injection allows attackers to interfere with queries. PREVENTION: Always use parameterized queries (prepared statements). Never use string concatenation for SQL. Use ORMs like SQLAlchemy safely. Implement the principle of least privilege for database accounts.

title: ACIP Remediation Reporting Standards
content: Remediation reports must include: CWE reference, Technical Impact, Remediation Code Snippet, and Verification Steps. The goal is to educate the developer, not just fix the bug.
